ayahs.tr: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
ayahs.tl: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth

ayahs.tr: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
ayahs.tl: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh

ayahs.tr: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for one whose scales are light,
ayahs.tl: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh

ayahs.tr: His refuge will be an abyss.
And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.
